想登录你的账户: wants to sign in to your account
Vaultwarden 或自建的 Bitwarden 服务器: Vaultwarden or a self-hosted Bitwarden server
WinVaultWarden 正在处理通行密钥请求。: WinVaultWarden is processing the passkey request.
下次用 Windows Hello 解锁？: Use Windows Hello to unlock next time?
不包含组织条目、回收站、附件和 Send: Excludes organization items, trash, attachments, and Sends
不常用但还想保留的条目可以归档，随时可以取消归档。: Archive items you want to keep but rarely use. You can unarchive them at any time.
个人密码库中的条目，包含已归档条目: Personal vault items, including archived items
仅显示本次解锁期间成功复制的内容，保险库锁定后清除。: Shows only values successfully copied during this unlock session. Cleared when the vault locks.
任何人都打不开链接: No one can open the link
作为 Windows 的通行密钥提供程序: Use as a Windows passkey provider
保存条目后可添加附件。: Save the item before adding attachments.
保留通知区域入口，便于重新打开窗口: Keep a notification area icon to reopen the window
修改后，其他设备都需要重新登录: Other devices must sign in again after this change
关联字段保留原有设置: Linked fields keep their existing settings
关闭后用单色首字母代替网站图标: Use monochrome initials instead of website icons when disabled
关闭时，截图和屏幕共享中看不到这个窗口: Hide this window from screenshots and screen sharing when disabled
再次同步检查只读取服务器状态，不会重新提交创建请求。: Checking again only reads the server state. It does not resubmit the creation request.
最小化时收起到通知区域: Move to the notification area when minimized
删除会永久移除内容。提前停止访问会保留内容，但接收者无法再打开链接。: Deletion permanently removes the content. Expiring access early keeps the content but prevents recipients from opening the link.
删除的条目会显示在这里，可恢复或永久删除。: Deleted items appear here. You can restore or permanently delete them.
到时连同链接一起删除，最长 30 天: Delete the content and link at this time, within 30 days
反馈问题时附上，不包含任何密码库内容: Include this when reporting an issue. It contains no vault content.
同时更换账户加密密钥: Also rotate the account encryption key
名称、用户名和网址都会被搜索: Search names, usernames, and website addresses
在另一台设备上批准前，确认那里显示的是同样的短语。: Before approving on another device, confirm that it displays the same phrase.
在新设备上登录时，除了主密码还要再验证一次。多开启几种方式，手边没有其中一种时可: Signing in on a new device requires another verification step after your master password. Enable multiple methods so you have an alternative when one is unavailable.
在随机一个单词后加一位数字: Add a digit after a random word
复制密码、验证码后到时清空: Clear copied passwords and verification codes after this interval
复制的内容不会出现在 Win + V 和云剪贴板里: Copied content is excluded from Win + V and the cloud clipboard
安全笔记内容请填写在下方备注中。: Enter the secure note in the notes field below.
密码库可保存 SSH 密钥。此版本尚未提供代理签名和程序授权，因此不会向 ssh: The vault can store SSH keys. This version does not provide agent signing or application authorization, so keys are not loaded into ssh, git, or other programs.
密码库已锁定。批准前需要先用 Windows Hello 解锁。: The vault is locked. Unlock with Windows Hello before approving.
对接收者隐藏我的电子邮箱地址: Hide my email address from recipients
对方看不到是谁发送的: Recipients cannot see who sent it
对方要点“显示”才能看到文本: Recipients must select Show to reveal the text
对方设备上会显示同样的短语，完全一致才批准。如果不是你本人在登录，请拒绝，并尽快: The requesting device displays the same phrase. Approve only if they match exactly. If you did not request this login, deny it and change your master password as soon as possible.
导入的条目会新增，不会覆盖已有条目: Imported items are added as new items and do not replace existing ones
已生成新密码并填好。先到网站上改好，再回来点“保存”。: A new password has been generated and filled in. Change it on the website first, then return here and select Save.
当前最小化会锁定并清除剪贴板，复制后最小化暂不可用: Minimizing currently locks the vault and clears the clipboard. Minimize after copying is unavailable.
当前没有待处理的登录请求。: There are no pending sign-in requests.
当前版本暂不支持更换账户加密密钥。: Account encryption key rotation is unavailable in this version.
当前版本的 PIN 可在重启后直接解锁，暂不支持此选项: This version allows PIN unlock after restart. This option is unavailable.
忘记主密码时可以发到你的邮箱，不能包含主密码本身: Can be emailed to you if you forget your master password. Do not include the password itself.
我已在请求设备上核对，指纹短语完全一致。: I checked the requesting device and the fingerprint phrases match exactly.
拥有链接的任何人均可访问；可设置密码或次数限制。: Anyone with the link can access it. You can add a password or access limit.
指定信任的人，在紧急情况下访问你的密码库: Choose someone you trust to access your vault in an emergency
指定信任的人。对方发起请求后，如果你在等待期内没有拒绝，对方就能查看或接管你的密: Choose someone you trust. After they request access, they can view or take over your vault unless you deny the request during the waiting period.
排查问题时查看，不包含密码库内容: View diagnostic logs containing no vault content
提交期间连接中断，服务器可能已经完成注册。应用不会自动重试，请先尝试登录；若无法: The connection was interrupted while submitting. Registration may have completed on the server. The app will not retry automatically. Try signing in first; if that fails, return to edit your information.
无法显示紧急访问信息。请检查连接后重试。: Unable to display emergency access information. Check your connection and try again.
更改后，其他设备都需要用新主密码重新登录。主密码无法找回，请确认你记得住它。: Other devices must sign in again with the new master password. Your master password cannot be recovered, so make sure you can remember it.
服务器已接受验证请求。若该地址可用于注册，请按邮件中的链接在 Web Vault: The server accepted the verification request. If the address is eligible for registration, follow the email link to complete the process in the Web Vault, then return to sign in.
查看、复制或编辑前要输入主密码: Require the master password before viewing, copying, or editing
检查/撤销其他设备会话后清除此隔离: Clear this quarantine after checking or revoking other device sessions
检查主密码是否出现在已知数据泄露中: Check whether the master password appears in known data breaches
此企业账户尚未建立加密密钥。继续后将完成账户恢复注册。: This enterprise account has no encryption keys yet. Continuing completes account recovery enrollment.
此字段的原有值将被保留: The existing value of this field will be kept
此版本仅提供简体中文: This version is available only in Simplified Chinese
此版本使用 WinUI 系统渲染，尚不支持关闭硬件加速: This version uses WinUI system rendering and cannot disable hardware acceleration
此版本尚未提供 SSH 代理: The SSH agent is unavailable in this version
此版本尚未提供。Windows 暂时无法将网站和应用的通行密钥请求交给 WinV: Unavailable in this version. Windows cannot forward website and application passkey requests to WinVaultWarden yet.
此版本尚未提供登录 Windows 后自动启动: Starting automatically after Windows sign-in is unavailable in this version
此版本尚未提供自动检查，可打开发布页: Automatic update checks are unavailable in this version. You can open the releases page.
永久删除账户和密码库里的全部数据，无法恢复: Permanently delete the account and all vault data. This cannot be undone.
清除全部本机数据并退出: Clear all local data and exit
清除本机缓存的密码库，下次需要联网登录: Clear the locally cached vault. An online sign-in will be required next time.
用 Windows Hello 确认是你本人: Confirm your identity with Windows Hello
用其中任意一种完成两步登录: Complete two-step login with any of these methods
用面部、指纹或 PIN 代替主密码，主密码仍然可以用。: Use your face, fingerprint, or PIN instead of your master password. You can still use the master password.
留空表示不限次数；达到限额后接收者无法查看。: Leave blank for unlimited access. Recipients cannot view the Send once the limit is reached.
禁用此 Send · 任何人都打不开链接: Disable this Send · No one can open the link
管理身份验证器应用、电子邮件和安全密钥: Manage authenticator apps, email, and security keys
粘贴别人发给你的 Send 链接。内容只在本机解密，不会存进你的密码库。: Paste a Send link you received. Its content is decrypted only on this device and is not saved to your vault.
编辑时留空会保留已有密码；替换受密码保护的文件时，请重新输入密码。: Leave blank when editing to keep the existing password. Re-enter it when replacing a password-protected file.
至少保留一类: Keep at least one character type
让 ssh、git 等程序使用密码库里的 SSH 密钥: Allow ssh, git, and other programs to use SSH keys from the vault
访问密码不正确，请重试。: The access password is incorrect. Try again.
输入组织标识符，会在浏览器中打开组织的登录页面: Enter the organization identifier to open its sign-in page in your browser
输入邮箱中的验证码: Enter the verification code from your email
过期后打不开，到删除时间才会删除: Access ends at expiration. Content is kept until the deletion date.
返回生成器并复制一个结果后，它会显示在这里。: Return to the generator and copy a result to see it here.
还没有人把你设为紧急联系人: No one has added you as an emergency contact yet
还没有已登记的设备，登录并同步后会显示在这里。: No registered devices yet. They appear here after you sign in and sync.
还没有检查过密码是否泄露: Password exposure has not been checked yet
选择备份格式和保护方式: Choose a backup format and protection method
闲置这么久之后锁定密码库: Lock the vault after this period of inactivity
验证主密码后，选择文件保存位置: Verify your master password, then choose where to save the file
